note: 0.6 (Osama, 7 November 2026). B-52H Stratofortress: new wing pylon choice 4x AGM-183A ARRW (+400; dev.37 had 2x for +300), the US hypersonic missile tested on the B-52H. The ARRW is a copy of the MiG-31K's Kh-47M2 Kinzhal HE (round 455: damage 70, penetration 250, range 5000, speed 1000; weapon 610; on a copy of the AGM-86C ALCM wing pylon, turret 590, dev.38) under its own name, so the MiG-31K's Kinzhal is unchanged. Two missiles per wing pylon on the same mounts as the 12x AGM-86C option (1094, mounts 1 and 2). Guess: Kinzhal HE stats, since the game has no ARRW data. Not yet run in a game.
name: AGM-183A ARRW
